description: What one stage drops on a game server: each item with drop rate (items per run), sanity per item, runs (times) and quantity, highest rate first, then the items it no longer drops; with the sanity cost of the stage and whether it is open now. For questions about a given stage. To find where to farm an item, call get_item_drop_rates instead: one call ranks every stage that drops it. Takes the stage ID from search_stages (codes are shared by several stages); a code works too if only one stage on the server has it.

lang.description: Language of the names in the result: the language the user writes in, zh, en, ja or ko (en for other languages, and if omitted).

server.description: Game server the user plays on: CN (mainland China: 国服, 官服, B服), US (global, English: 国际服, 美服), JP (日服) or KR (韩服). Stages, events and drop rates differ by server. Use the server the user named or the conversation makes clear; a user writing Chinese, Japanese or Korean most likely plays CN, JP or KR. If you can't tell, ask the user which server they play on before calling. Name the server in your answer.

stage_id.description: Stage ID, from search_stages: main_01-07. A code works too if only one stage on the server has it: 1-7

name: get_stage_drops

dataAsOf.description: When the drop data was calculated, RFC 3339 in UTC

rows.description: The items the stage drops, highest rate first; then those of windows that ended (end not null), which it no longer drops, such as the bonus drops of past events

end.description: End of the window, RFC 3339 in UTC; null while it goes on

itemName.description: Name in the language asked for

start.description: Start of the window, RFC 3339 in UTC

attribution.description: The credit to give wherever this data is used

url.description: The page of this data on Penguin Statistics, or its home page

apCost.description: Sanity cost of a run; null without one (gachas, the recruitment)

code.description: Code in the language asked for

existsOn.description: Game servers the stage exists on

openNow.description: Whether the stage is open on the server now, by the open and close times of the stage and its zone; supply and chip stages (zoneType WEEKLY) count as open every day, as their weekday rotation is not tracked

pageUrl.description: Page of the drops of the stage on Penguin Statistics, on the server or else the first server it exists on; null if there is none

zoneName.description: Name of the zone in the language asked for

zoneType.description: MAINLINE (the main story), ACTIVITY (an event), ACTIVITY_PERMANENT (a side story or intermezzo, open for good), WEEKLY (supplies and chips), GACHABOX or RECRUIT

truncated.description: Whether items were left out, past 100

title: Stage drops
